extraction_hints: This mission's form set ('ISHI-2015') has NO checkbox/tick-box roster anywhere for Surgeon, Assistant, Anesthesiologist, or CRNA -- every one of these fields on every page (H&P/Brief Op Note 'Surgeon, Assistant:' line, OR Record 'Surgeon:'/'Assistant:'/'Anesthesiologist/CRNA:' lines) is free-text handwriting. Transcribe whatever name(s) are written; do not expect or search for tick-box initials anywhere on this mission.

The History and Physical and the Brief Op Note are combined onto a single page on this mission's form set (unlike other Ghana missions where they may be separate pages) -- both sets of fields should be read from that one page.

Each source packet contains multiple blank, unused copies of several page templates (Notes, Floor Flowsheet, PACU Flowsheet, Orders). These blank pages are normal padding, not a scanning error -- leave their fields blank when no handwriting is present rather than flagging as an anomaly.
This mission's form set does not include a Post-Op Visit page -- leave that field blank/flagged as usual rather than treating its absence as an error.

A one-page cover/summary sheet (MRN box, patient name, procedure, 'Seen By' initials, anesthesia checkboxes, surgery date/time) appears on some but not all packets -- treat it as optional, not a required page.
_calibration: Calibrated from sample packets before the full run (calibration notes withheld from the public release).
